description: Register a brewing scale — the instrument that weighs the dose and the yield.

auto_tare.description: 1 if it zeroes itself when a vessel is set down, 0 if not, null if unstated

auto_timer.description: 1 if the timer starts on first flow, 0 if not, null if unstated

capacity_g.description: Maximum weight in grams. The cup or portafilter counts against it

connectivity.description: How the scale talks to an app or a machine controller

flow_rate_display.description: 1 if the scale shows live flow rate in g/s, 0 if it does not, null if the maker never said

height_mm.description: Overall height in mm — the dimension that decides whether it fits under a group head

name.description: Scale name/model, e.g. Acaia Lunar, Timemore Black Mirror Basic 2

power.description: How it is powered or recharged

resolution_banded.description: 1 when resolution_g only holds in the lowest weight band and coarsens with load — put the ladder in notes

resolution_g.description: Finest published readability in grams. Leave null unless the maker states it

scale_type.description: What the scale is built for: espresso (drip-tray footprint), brew (pour-over platform), dual (both modes), connected (app/controller integration), dosing (gravimetric dispensing), training, bench (high capacity, coarse)

water_resistance.description: IEC 60529 ingress code as published, e.g. IPX4, IPX6, IP67, or none

width_mm.description: Platform width in mm — measure your drip tray

name: register_scale
title: Register a scale
